'''Janissa Locrin''' was a reclusive [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] star who used [[Devaron/Legends|Devaronian]] [[watchbeast]]s to protect her house. Even with that security measures, [[Seland' Ir]] from the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] organized a raid in her home to kidnap her, so that they could ask the producers for a ransom.
